label: batch-64
tail:
Batch 64’s 13 draft items, A/B pages, manifest, proof contracts, source coverage, cross-batch evidence, and notes are reconciled. I recorded all 13 items as `ready` for author completion; this is not independent approval.

The main repairs include removing an unsupported maximum stepsize restriction from the root-convergence theorem, making conditional-moment and integrability prerequisites explicit, and stating the biased-noise result as a limit-superior bound. I also corrected display formulas that failed rendering checks.

Scoped checks passed: strict proof contracts (11 items), precheck (11), proof layout (11 items, 38 steps), rendercheck (15 files), depcheck (13 items and 2 pages), content policy (13 items), and source coverage (26 entries). Source fetch verification passed for all 4 cited PDFs, with no new stamps required. The inspected treatments include the [Bubeck monograph](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1405.4980), [Bottou–Curtis–Nocedal](https://leon.bottou.org/publications/pdf/tr-optml-2016.pdf), and [Ghadimi–Lan](https://optimization-online.org/wp-content/uploads/2012/06/3499.pdf); the [Bertsekas appendix](https://web.mit.edu/dimitrib/www/Appendix_A_NEW_ALG.pdf) is recorded as statement-only context.

The run-wide item-level check still exits with errors outside this batch: 56 other page inventories are empty, and three other items have mismatched levels. Batch 64’s 13 levels recompute correctly. I left those outside-scope findings for their owners; the exact IDs are in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-64.notes.md).
